synthesis.title: L3-L10 validation status after blocked documentation pass
synthesis.summary: V3.14 through V10.52 are all BLOCKED, not validated. The repo remains pre-implementation, so no empirical proof exists for IPC, watcher lifecycle, context construction, ticking, delivery, profile resolution, end-to-end flow, or failure modes. Each item now has a concrete implementation bead xe-2iy.6 through xe-2iy.44 and a knb claim with passing behavior, fixture shape, and the primary design question. This completes the documentation-of-gap pass for all remaining validation items.
synthesis.limitations: These rows prove traceability and fixture design, not working behavior. Empirical validation still waits for eyesd and related implementation work.
